title: skills(pm-dispatch): `pm:awaiting-maintainer` has a semantic contract and zero machine carrier — 49 of 55 cards in it are waiting for a JUDGEMENT, not for a hand, and nothing can tell the two apart
body:
Filed on the maintainer's direct instruction, 2026-09-09, replying to a director-format decision batch: 「5986 这种任务不影响我们的产品质量，不应该让人类决策，项目经理自己当场决定就可以，而且这个应该开技能卡纠正」 and, on a second card, 「这个不应该是决策卡吗？哪个流程出了问题？」.

⛔ Filed unassigned. `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/**` is the `domain:skills` lane's governed surface.

## The measurement that opened this

Full enumeration of both multi-lane repos plus hotcrm, 2026-09-09, reading only `state:OPEN`:

| repo | `pm:awaiting-maintainer` |
|---|--:|
| objectstack | 37 |
| objectui | 16 |
| hotcrm | 2 |
| **total** | **55** |

Two enumerations ~14h apart: **55 → 55, unchanged**, while `pm:queue` across the three repos moved 562 → 478 (−84) in the same interval. ⇒ This state is the only one on the board that does not move.

Classifying all 55 by what the maintainer actually owes:

- **~6** are what the label is defined as — one action a seat cannot perform: set a repository variable (objectui#5986/#7852), cut a release (#16500), run a probe against a published image (#12675), reproduce on macOS (#12884), act on an account outside `GOVERNED_APPROVERS` (#15406).
- **~23** need the maintainer's **judgement**, not their hand: #13636 (a third tenancy state the ruling cannot express), objectui#7833 (should AGENTS.md carry this rule?), objectui#7800 (this sentence needs a maintainer), hotcrm#1498 (which driver is canon for NULL as an operand), #12034 (which producer wins), …
- **~24** need **neither** — bookkeeping, dedup, doc wording, gate internals, invariant restoration with no product-semantic fork.

⇒ **~49 of 55 are misfiled**, and ~24 of those should never have left a seat at all.

## Which process failed — traced on #12034, which is the clean specimen

#12034 was `pm:dispatched`. Its delivering PR #13060 merged 2026-08-29T03:03:42Z; the card kept the label for ~36h; H8 fired; a seat did the paired write on 2026-08-30 and chose `pm:awaiting-maintainer`. **That comment's own body says why the choice was wrong** (`5469455426`, verbatim):

> ⇒ 故 `pm:awaiting-maintainer`。**裁完之后**按你的选择：留在本卡（选项 A）或另立新卡（选项 B）承接。

「裁完之后」 is the definition of `needs-user-decision`. `SKILL.md:110` / `:126`:

> `pm:awaiting-maintainer` | 决定**已做**，只剩一次 GitHub 之外的人工动作
> `needs-user-decision` 是决定**待做**，`pm:on-hold` 是决定已做

Three defects let that stand, and all three are in the skill, not in the seat:

**① H8 checks that the paired write happened, never which state it wrote to.** The predicate is "delivering PR MERGED while the card still carries `pm:dispatched`". Any terminal state discharges it. There is no successor predicate asking whether the chosen state matches the card's own thread.

**② The distinction between the two states has no machine carrier.** Every other parked state carries a mandatory machine-readable line — `pm:blocked` owes `Blocked-by: #N`, `pm:on-hold` owes `Restart-when:` (and `references/state-machine.md` calls any other spelling illegal). `pm:awaiting-maintainer` owes **nothing**. Anyone can apply it and no reader can falsify it.

**③ The half-state patrol is structurally blind here, and says so itself.** `scripts/pm/check-half-states.mjs:2298`, verbatim:

> `pm:awaiting-maintainer` has no machine exit BY CONSTRUCTION (that is why it exists)

Its predicates over this state are H25 (must not coexist with another pm state — *shape*), H29/H30/H31 (six-state ONE-OF — *shape*), H22 (residue on a closed card — *shape*), and the important-parked ager (*time*). ⇒ **Shape and time only. Nothing reads meaning.** No machine exit means no machine can notice the state was entered wrongly.

And the misclassification cannot self-correct downstream: `references/state-machine.md` puts the exit solely with the director seat, which is 人工定期召唤、无 Routine 无 cron and gated at `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`. ⇒ a wrong entry has exactly one reviewer, who is often absent or under tier. That is the mechanism behind 55 → 55.

## What this card asks for — two halves, one landing surface

### Half A — give the state a carrier, so the two are separable by machine

A card entering `pm:awaiting-maintainer` carries a mandatory line naming the action and its verifiable completion, on the model of `Blocked-by:` / `Restart-when:`. Working spelling for the claimant to refine:

```
Maintainer-action: <one action a seat cannot perform> — done when <machine-checkable evidence>
```

A card in the state without that line is a half-state ⇒ new sweep predicate, and the natural remedy text is *"if the line cannot be written because the card is asking for a ruling, the state is `needs-user-decision`"*. The line also gives the director seat's 职责三 台账 something to render, and gives the ager a completion criterion instead of just an age.

⚠️ Explicitly **not** asked for: a machine *exit*. `check-half-states.mjs:2298` is right that the state has none by construction. This is an entry predicate, not an exit one.

### Half B — write the floor of what may reach the maintainer at all

The skill says a great deal about *how* to escalate and almost nothing about what must **never** be escalated. `SKILL.md` 〈升级与决策〉 has 具名不升级类 (恢复不变量的修复; 技术任务间的顺序与依赖; 验证策略) — the maintainer's ruling adds a class this list does not cover:

> 「这种任务不影响我们的产品质量，不应该让人类决策，项目经理自己当场决定就可以」

Specimen: objectui#5986 — two cards were open for one repository-variable click, and the question *"which of the two survives"* was carried to the maintainer inside a decision batch. That is bookkeeping. It has no product-quality surface, no contract shape, no acceptance-set movement. It belongs on the seat that noticed it.

⇒ Extend 具名不升级类 to name: **去重与卡片合并；台账与记账整理；纯文档措辞更正（无契约声明改动）；门禁内部参数与扫描器盲区修复（加强，非削弱）**. ⛔ The four items above must not be readable as widening — each is bounded by "no product-visible behaviour changes", and the 人工地板 list (`SKILL.md:391-393`) is untouched and remains the exclusion set.

## Constraints the claimant must respect

- `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/SKILL.md` is a **强制条款①** surface ⇒ the PR is built at `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER` regardless of its content.
- `check-skill-line-ratchet.mjs`: `SKILL.md`'s line count **only ever goes down**, and it currently sits at its ceiling with **0 headroom** (811/811, measured on PR #16915's gate table). ⇒ this edit must pay for itself by deletion; ⛔ re-wrapping does not count. Half B is plausibly net-negative (it collapses a class into an existing list); Half A adds a carrier and will need to find its own payment.
- Governed surface ⇒ terminal four-piece treatment: draft PR, `needs-user-decision`, a 「维护者速读」 comment, review requested from both authorised accounts; ⛔ no seat approves or merges.
- ⚠️ **Do not backfill the 55 in the same PR.** Reclassifying existing cards is a separate, per-card act that reads each thread; landing a predicate that instantly reds ~49 cards is the "gate goes red on the healthy case" shape objectui#6596 already ruled against. Sequence: rule first, then a bounded reclassification worklist.

## Executable acceptance criterion

`SKILL.md` states the `Maintainer-action:` carrier and that a card in `pm:awaiting-maintainer` without it is a half-state; 具名不升级类 names the four bookkeeping classes; `pnpm check:pm-skill-ratchet` passes (line count not increased); `check:skill-frame-sync` / `-freshness` pass; `check-half-states.mjs` gains the entry predicate with self-test cases, and its own self-test suite stays green.

Refs: #12034 (the specimen, and the comment that misfiled it: `5469455426`) · objectui#5986 / objectui#7852 (the bookkeeping specimen, both closed 2026-09-09) · `scripts/pm/check-half-states.mjs:2298` (the by-construction blindness) · `references/state-machine.md` (exit ownership) · objectui#6596 (red-on-healthy)
